 GREAT SAVE! published at 55 mins 55 mins 
 Chelsea 0-0 Paris St-Germain 
 Once again PSG's Merveille Kanjinga is causing problems.
 She skips over a challenge from Katie McCabe on the edge of the penalty area and blasts the ball goallwards. 
 But Hannah Hampton makes her first real save of the evening and it's a good one too, down quickly at her near post to push the ball away.

 England defender Carter joins Bay FC published at 21:09 GMT 21:09 GMT 
 Image source, Getty Images It was announced earlier this evening that England defender Jess Carter has completed a move to Bay FC after leaving Gotham FC as a free agent.
 The 29-year-old has signed a contract that will keep her with Bay FC - a club based in the San Francisco Bay Area - until 2028, with the option for an additional year.
 Carter joined New York-side Gotham in July 2024 after a six-year spell with Chelsea that saw her win the Women's Super League on five occasions.
 "Coming to Bay FC is a new challenge, and that's something I'm excited about," said Carter.
 "I've been fortunate to be part of some successful teams, and I know how much work goes into winning. I'm looking forward to getting to know this group, earning the trust of my teammates and doing my part to help us move forward."

BBC Sport women’s football news reporter at Plough Lane 
 Sonia Bompastor has made changes at the break. The Alyssa Thompson left wing-back experiment didn't pay off. 
 Sandy Baltimore moves into that position - but higher up - as Chelsea are now in a back four defensively. 
 Thompson has come across to the right-wing position.

 Shaw gets another goal before taking a tumble published at 20:57 GMT 20:57 GMT 
 FT: Hacken 0-2 Man City 
 Manchester City won 2-0 at Hacken earlier on and Khadija Shaw, the WSL's top scorer with 12 goals in 10 games, was on target again with City's second.
 Her momentum then took her head first over the advertising hoardings, although thankfully she was OK to carry on.
 Have a watch...
